hypothesis: Selection-bias-aware PU learning: estimate e(x)=P(labeled|fault,x) with SAR-EM from local relief, slope, gravity-derived basin-fill proxy, LiDAR coverage, and distance to range front; compare propensity-aware risk (weights clipped at 10) with nnPU on identical blocked folds.
mechanism: Catalogue positives may be easier to map in steep, high-relief, LiDAR-covered range-front terrain; modeling the selection process may reduce label-selection bias and improve recovery of less-visible faults.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Lithologic contacts, density contrasts at basin margins, erosional scarps, and survey/access patterns can covary with the proposed terrain and gravity covariates without representing a fault.
